18.headline: Dončić scores 46 against the 1 seed and makes it look rude
18.dek: Manhattan won at Stony Brook with half its rotation in street clothes, Toronto took the 2 seed, Waltham forgot how to win, and Cambridge is suddenly a problem.

games.text: Manhattan arrived at the 1 seed's building without Karl-Anthony Towns, Damian Lillard or Kon Knueppel, which in most leagues is called an excuse. Luka Dončić called it a larger share of the shots. He scored 46 on 17-of-25 with 13 assists, the Elephants won the fourth quarter 31-20, and Stony Brook lost 115-104 in a game it had tied at 84. Manhattan keeps the 4 seed at 10-8. The Stingrays keep the 1 seed, though they may want to check that it is still plugged in.

Jayson Tatum made nine 3-pointers, scored 31 points and recorded zero assists, which tells you roughly how the evening went for his teammates. Toronto scored 39 in the first quarter, won the third 33-18 and left with a 120-105 win and the 2 seed, Jaylen Brown supplying 27 points and 10 rebounds. Waltham has lost three straight and fallen from the 5 seed to the 7 seed, a slide the Bears are handling with the calm of a man watching his car roll downhill.

Three weeks ago Cambridge was a punchline with a platypus on it. The Platypuses have now won five straight, the latest a 116-91 dismantling of Durham that was 63-39 at halftime and did not get more polite. Victor Wembanyama scored 27. Herbert Jones took six 3-pointers and missed one, presumably out of mercy. The Destroyers, who destroyed nothing, slipped from the 2 seed to the 3 seed. Cambridge is the 6 seed, a single game below the playoff line, and nobody above it is sleeping well.

Ithaca and Queens traded the lead 16 times, like two people being too polite at a door, until the Thunder finally walked through it. Deni Avdija scored 28 and Nikola Jokić filed his usual paperwork: 18 points, 14 rebounds, 13 assists. The 114-106 win lifts Ithaca to the 5 seed, tied on record with the 3 and 4 seeds. Queens got 21 from Jalen Green and an assortment of shrugs from everyone else, and stays the 8 seed.

The 9 seed hosted the 10 seed, and league rules regrettably require one of them to win. Gooning did, 117-105, after trailing by 11, because Tyrese Haliburton made seven 3-pointers on his way to 29 points and Kawhi Leonard added 25 between rest days. Evan Mobley had 23 points and 10 assists for Rochester, which was missing Paolo Banchero and Tyler Herro, has lost three straight and is 5-13. The Dragons remain the 10 seed, a position from which the only way is sideways.
